description: Anthropic's model list shows a model that is not a Claude model under its own name.

exceptions.reason: Today's core lists a model whose name does not start with claude- under a made-up Claude name (claude-fable-5-dd- and the name reversed) unless disable-cloaking-model-list is set, and turns it back on requests; the new core never makes one model look like another, so it lists the name clients use (making other clients look like Claude Code is out of scope).
